# Plan (opus, strong) ## Goal A live match that the server voids (close code 4410, `VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE`) after the board has loaded shows a "no longer available" alert on the board, with a link back. On `/match` the link is "Back to the lobby" (`/play`). On `/duos` it is "Back to Play together" (`/together`), on both the own board and the teammate's. The status line keeps `data-connection="closed"`. An ordinary drop still shows "Reconnecting…" and the "Reconnect now" button, with no gone notice. ## Files to touch | Path | new/change | What | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx` | change | `matchTestid.gone` doc comment; new `gone` const; the `boardNotice` prop of `` | | `apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx` | change | new `describe("a match voided mid-game (#1899)")` with 3 tests | | `apps/web/src/duos/context.ts` | change | `DuosChrome.notice?: ReactNode` | | `apps/web/src/duos/DuosBoard.tsx` | change | `boardNotice={chrome?.notice}` on both `` elements | | `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.tsx` | change | `notice` entry in the `chrome` `useMemo` | | `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.test.tsx` | change | `within` import; new `describe("the co-op route voided mid-game (#1899)")` with 2 tests | | `apps/web/src/duos/testids.ts` | change | doc comment of `gone` | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | two new entries | | `apps/web/src/game/net.ts` | change | doc comment of `ConnectionState`'s `"closed"` member only | Do not touch `apps/web/src/duos/socket.ts`, the logic in `apps/web/src/game/net.ts`, `connectionWords` in either route, `apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.tsx`, any CSS, `e2e/`, `crates/` or `spec/`. No spec section or ruling governs this. It is presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7). R679 (a voided match closes both sockets) is unchanged and is not cited anew. No ruling, no patch fragment. **What the code does today (why this design):** in both `net.ts` and `duos/socket.ts`, `connection` becomes `"closed"` only when 4410 arrives or `close()` runs. `close()` runs only in `useMatch`/`useDuosMatch`'s unmount cleanup. So while a route is mounted, `"closed"` means voided. The pre-view #1599 panels already rely on this. The server sends the last view (result `{ winner: "draw", reason: "voided" }`) and then 4410. A client that was reconnecting during the void keeps a stale, live-looking view and hears only 4410. ## Steps 1. **`apps/web/src/game/net.ts`, `ConnectionState`.** Replace the doc comment above `| "closed";`, which reads ``/** `close()` was called. */``, with: ``/** `close()` was called, or the server closed the socket with VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE (R679): the match is gone, and nothing reopens it until `connect()`. */`` Change no code. 2. **`apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`, `matchTestid`.** Replace the doc comment of `gone` with: `/** #1599, #1899: the sentence that stands in for a socket closed for good (a voided match): the panel's before any view, the board's notice once it is up. */` 3. **`apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`, `MatchRoute`.** Directly above `const board = (`, after the `graceMs` block, add: ```ts // #1899: a socket closed for good once the board is up — the server voided the match // (VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE, game/net.ts; `close()` runs only as this route unmounts) — has nothing to // reconnect to, so the board says the match is gone and offers the lobby. const gone = match.connection === "closed"; ``` In the `` element, replace the whole `boardNotice={...}` prop with: ```tsx boardNotice={ gone ? Leave the `error`, `matchStatus` and `ConnectionLine` code alone. 4. **`apps/web/src/duos/context.ts`, `DuosChrome`.** After `onWatchReplay?: () => void;`, add: ```ts /** #1899: the route's alert about the match itself (a voided match's), in either duel's board notices (Game's `boardNotice`). */ notice?: ReactNode; ``` `ReactNode` is already imported. 5. **`apps/web/src/duos/DuosBoard.tsx`.** On both ` {t("This co-op match is no longer available.")}{" "} {t("Back to Play together")}

- Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test rules r1020`; the full `--test rules`; `cargo test -p jackioh-tools fuzz_regression_corpus`; `cargo jackioh fuzz --regress`; `cargo jackioh fuzz --from 3760 --seeds 1` and `--from 5609 --seeds 1` (each `1 passed`); `cargo jackioh fuz…
- ## Done when
- - [ ] Seeds 3760 and 5609 pass; `--regress` replays the new record green; both new `r1020_` tests pass and fail with step 4 reverted.
- - [ ] The Log test passes; specs 36 and 40 pass locally, output in the PR.
- - [ ] Step-12 wave times and results in the PR; the PR names the fixed super jobs (fuzz 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, e2e 1/8, 4/8) and how each was checked.
- - [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, clippy on touched crates, cargo tests with no diff under `apps/web/src/wire/`, web tests, and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` reporting no card that plays differently (views only).
- ## Risks
- - **Over-hiding.** A card reads unread only when gone from state and last put in a library, where it was hidden anyway. Guarded by `cargo jackioh golden check` (replays views) plus the full rules suite.
- - **Duos.** The new check runs before the `duel` branch; a pass takes hand cards, never library ones, so R1074000 is unchanged; still run `--duos --seeds 200`.
- - **Determinism.** View-only: no state, hash or replay change.
- - **Spec 36.** The helper stays in hand and is read by `readHands` like any held card; if a later catalog drops CN in a Bottle, `source` is `undefined` and Prestige fails as now (the last spec test names it).
- - **Spec 40.** Rounds with no qualifying enemy unit just pass the turn; `TURN_BUDGET` (12) still bounds the wait.
- ## Open questions
- - Prestige's seat is dealt CN in a Bottle, which puts a Radiant card in hand. Rejected: counting a Trade of Prestige as its play (weakens "every card played"); dealing H1B Printer (needs a play and a turn). A person may prefer another source.
- - No workflow change is needed. One observation for a person: super.yml runs each shard's handicapped wave only when its plain wave passes, so shards 2 and 3 never ran theirs; the Duos/handicap-only failures (if any) belong in a follow-up.
- Confirmed: `catalog-version` prints `v0.4.12c`, matching the record name in the plan. No change needed — the plan stands as delivered.
